render_octree_scene: render a DfsOctree scene with camera extrinsics and intrinsics using OctreeRenderer
convert_intrinsics_to_projection: convert OpenCV camera intrinsics to an OpenGL perspective projection matrix
render_voxel_octree: render a voxel-based octree using OctreeVoxelRasterizer with density and SH features
render_gaussian_octree: render a gaussian-based octree using OctreeGaussianRasterizer with opacity and SH features
render_trivec_octree: render a trivec-based octree using OctreeTrivecRasterizer with density and trivec features
